The model is described as a powerful, efficient Ministral 3 variant with text and vision capabilities for edge and local deployment.

notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/ministral-3-8b-25-12). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, license, params, modalities tooltips, features, pricing), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Specs come from the page HTML/RSC (header, modalities tooltips Text/Image input and Text output, Weights table Parameters/Active/Context for Instruct, Reasoning, and Base; GPU RAM 67-8 GB). The page links to Blog (mistral.ai/news/mistral-3) and Technical Report (arxiv.org/abs/2601.08584 / seed key mistral-ministral-3-paper); those were not used because seed-lookup listed only this document for the card.
